correctness.rationale: Using the exact radial moments a_j and the three-branch bilateral Toeplitz weights, independently reconstructed the weighted shift C_{m,n}e_j=c_j e_{j+n-m}. Trigamma positivity gives strict log-convexity and hence c_j=0 precisely on |m-n|+1 consecutive indices; the reflection c_{m-n-j}=-c_j doubles all nonzero singular values. Second-order gamma expansion yields c_j~(α+1)mn/j² on both tails; counting inversion gives N²s_N→4(α+1)mn, Schatten p>1/2 and the sharp harmonic logarithmic sum. Independently checked 12 degree/weight combinations with high precision over 61 indices and at j=2000,8000; finite checks do not prove the asymptotic.
